source_supported: SNL37:039 lists two M641 triangular fulcrum brackets, each with one 1/4 x 1-3/4 inch split pin; no separate fulcrum pin is listed in that assembly.
SNL116:020 lists ten M640 rocking levers: eight center-rod applications and one on each M641. This increment models only the two M641 applications.

SNL172:002 lists six 11/16 x 1-1/2 inch button-head rivets for plate M1936 and bracket printed M6412; the final 2 is present in the scan. Association with M641 is selected provisionally, not silently corrected.
M578 rear foot-brake rods terminate between the retained horizontal fulcrum and a center foot-brake rocker, with M569C fork ends.
M568C (39.6875 mm selected under-head length) is reused with the M569C forks; M568A is not substituted.
approximations: M641 reconstructed as triangular floor flange with integral upright vertical journal, retained above M640 by listed 1/4 x 1-3/4 inch split pin. HB92 plan shows complete rocker face; side view shows edge of foot rocker and vertical journal. No unlisted separate fulcrum pin.

M640 reconstructed with journal and two rod eyes on the SAME side of its pivot. HB92 intermediate-shaft side view and foot-bracket plan view support this topology. Selected eye radii 76.2/101.6 mm, 25.4 mm journal, 25.65 mm bore, 34 mm hub width, 44.45 mm boss, and 12 mm eye width remain estimates; qualitative source ratio only, not printed dimensions.

M641 pivot station X3350/Y +/-521.3976048 remains provisional. Lever distal arm points aft/inboard at 45 degrees in plan. Both rod pin axes vertical. Journal height is constrained by retained M4132 rear pin Z625.125 with a level straight M578 route; footprint and casting profile estimated.

M578 rear rod joins the outer M640 eye; M579 center rod will join the inner eye. Two independent sources show same-side rod connections. Radii and neutral clocking remain approximate and subject to full route reconciliation.
M578 19.05 mm solid rod core and 19.05 mm fork insertion are estimates; smooth nominal threads retained.
Rivet stock length interpreted under head, upset conserves interpreted stock; SNL172 M6412 suffix unresolved.
requirements: Real floor-6 receiver holes, all existing plate features preserved.
Full rivet grip and bearing faces; no floor mating exemptions.
Journal engagement, rocker bore continuity and retention; complete fork/pin/cotter clearance against upright.
Actual rod socket engagement, correct M568C pin, receiver axes and thread/nut coverage.
Independent full retained-material context, nominal/variation, strict native/STEP, additive/revised-definition preservation.
